question: As of July 15, 2026, what GAAP diluted EPS range and adjusted diluted EPS range was Hormel Foods guiding to for fiscal 2026?
grading: Key points (both required): GAAP diluted EPS guidance USD 1.28-1.37 (updated May 28, 2026, previously 1.37-1.46) AND adjusted diluted EPS guidance USD 1.43-1.51 (reaffirmed). Fail if the Aug 27, 2026 ranges (GAAP 1.06-1.12; adjusted 1.45-1.51) are given as in effect on July 15, 2026, or if only one of the two measures is provided.
answer: As of July 15, 2026 the guidance in effect was the one issued with Hormel's Q2 fiscal 2026 results on May 28, 2026: GAAP diluted EPS of USD 1.28-1.37 (lowered from USD 1.37-1.46 to include the loss on the sale of the whole-bird turkey business) and adjusted diluted EPS of USD 1.43-1.51 (reaffirmed; +4% to +10%) for fiscal 2026 (ending October 25, 2026) [H05-E1]. The Q3 update on August 27, 2026 (GAAP USD 1.06-1.12; adjusted USD 1.45-1.51) came after the as_of date [H05-E2]. Between May 28 and July 15 Hormel filed only Item 5.02 officer-change 8-Ks, no guidance changes [H05-E3].

output.answer:
**As of July 15, 2026**, Hormel Foods' fiscal 2026 guidance (as updated in its Q2 FY2026 report on May 28, 2026, and unchanged until the August 27 Q3 report) was:

| Metric | Fiscal 2026 Guidance |
|---|---|
| **GAAP diluted EPS** | **$1.28 – $1.37** |
| **Adjusted diluted EPS** (non-GAAP) | **$1.43 – $1.51** |

Context:
- The GAAP range was *lowered* at Q2 from the prior $1.37–$1.46, to reflect adjustments including a loss on the sale of the whole-bird turkey business ($0.09), the T&M initiative ($0.06–$0.07), corporate restructuring charges ($0.01), a consulting agreement ($0.01), partly offset by a gain on the Justin's divestiture ($(0.03)).
- The **adjusted diluted EPS range of $1.43–$1.51 was reaffirmed** (representing ~4%–10% growth). This matched the original guidance first issued with FY2025 results and reiterated at Q1 FY2026.

Note: This date-specific guidance changed later — at the Q3 FY2026 report (August 27, 2026), GAAP EPS guidance was cut to $1.06–$1.12 while adjusted EPS was raised/narrowed to $1.45–$1.51.

Sources:
- [Hormel Foods Reports Strong Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results](https://www.hormelfoods.com/newsroom/press-releases/hormel-foods-reports-strong-second-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)
- [Investor Relations – Q2 FY2026 Release](https://investor.hormelfoods.com/news-and-events/news/news-details/2026/HORMEL-FOODS-REPORTS-STRONG-SECOND-QUARTER-FISCAL-2026-RESULTS/default.aspx)
